assumptions: Extensional total set-like types; all displayed functions total and correctly typed.
urn:csabs:axiom/product-beta-second.name: product-beta-second
urn:csabs:axiom/product-beta-second.statement: The second projection of a pair is its second component.

urn:csabs:concept/ProductType.axiomBasis: Extensional total set-like types: constructor/eliminator beta and eta equations; operation-definition equations where specified. Equality of functions is pointwise; no divergence, effects, or bottom values.
urn:csabs:concept/ProductType.basisScope: Defining interface and selected derived results for the operations listed in this entry. Not an enumeration of all consequences or all alternative foundations.
urn:csabs:concept/ProductType.definition: A type whose values contain one value from each component type.
urn:csabs:concept/ProductType.leanModelLimitations: Selected carrier/interface interpretation only. No blanket witness for all recorded operations, axioms, laws or theorems; consult binders and individual witness mappings.
urn:csabs:concept/ProductType.mathematicalFormulation: A×B has constructor pair:A→B→A×B and projections π₁,π₂. π₁(pair(a,b))=a; π₂(pair(a,b))=b; pair(π₁(p),π₂(p))=p.
urn:csabs:concept/ProductType.reviewStatus: editorial basis review; no machine-checked mathematical proof
urn:csabs:concept/ProductType.specializationNote: Use the constant family B(a)=B. Pair/fst/snd become the ordinary product constructor/projections; transported equality becomes component equality. No automatic inheritance of claims.
verificationObligation: Instantiate type parameters and operation domains.
Function equality here is extensional; translating to intensional type theory may require function extensionality.
Account separately for nontermination, exceptions, mutation, or untagged representation in concrete software.
Use the stated carriers, equality, domain restrictions and semantic conventions; alternative conventions require an explicit variant.

urn:csabs:operation/product-pair.description: Constructs a product from its two components.
urn:csabs:operation/product-pair.name: pair
